description: The top of PLATINUM ROAD: the neon PLATINUM ROAD masthead sign with its Yellowtail script accent, the neon-road progress bar with per-grade counts, the full dash-panel control row (search, kind and grade filters, earned-state filter, spoiler shield, export/import), and the first mile-marker trophy cards with several already stamped EARNED.

The Roadmap to Platinum rendered as six highway exit signs — Story First, The Inner Circle, Leonida Completionist, Thrill Seeker, Vice Grinder and The Final Mile — each sign listing its trophies as chips with a per-stage earned progress meter.

A trophy detail view open on The Shootist, a silver trophy: its official description, grade and kind tags, the original guide text, the Exophase / PSNProfiles sources line, and its gold-medal target counter part-filled at 27 of 42.
The spoiler shield switched ON in the dash panel: unearned story trophies are masked as SPOILER SEALED with blurred descriptions, while the one already-earned story trophy stays fully readable.
